page.overview:
Who is Baron von Schreck?

Baron von Schreck, cousin to the Elector Count of Averland, is a powerful and influential noble within the Empire. Arrogant and proud, the baron is feared and hated by the commoners within his demesne, whom he treats with contempt and loathing. He lives for such highborn pursuits as hunting, fencing and feasting, and has very little time for those he perceives as below him.

When the Truthsayer Fiornal arrived before the baron in his court one day, von Schreck became intrigued by his tale of the long lost isle of Albion. The idea of travelling to the far distant isle appealed to his sense of adventure, but more importantly to his greed, for the Truthsayer spoke of a land of untold power and ancient treasures.

Baron von Schreck is a ruthlessly effective Imperial general, and his army has performed well on the battlefields of Albion. Only having been on Albion for a few weeks, he has already campaigned successfully against several savage Beastman warbands, accomplishing a number of outstanding victories by outmaneuvering the brutish creatures. His scouts report that these tribes, crippled by their losses to von Schreck, have been harried by a rapidly-moving High Elf force and driven far into the marshes.

However, despite his victories, von Schreck has gained the enmity of several other Imperial forces on the isle through his unorthodox and callous methods of warfare. His total disregard for the vast majority of his troops has caused friction between himself and several other Imperial commanders. In battle, the baron will often use his state troop infantry as a living screen for his well-bred knights, protecting them from incoming missile-fire. In other instances, he has been known to maneuver his common troops into near-suicidal situations in order to lure the enemy into a position where he can counter-attack with his elite forces.
